dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, crenulated light-colored perimeters forming interlocking 'O' and 'C' shapes. The transition exhibits a soft gradient from a high-intensity light-grey exterior border to a lower-intensity dark-brown interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of localized high-intensity pixel clusters; small, solid light-toned speckles are visible primarily in the interstitial spaces between larger annular structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the mid-lateral flank form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the longest axis oriented horizontally along the body length.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, circular greyish-white focal lesion is visible on the mid-posterior lateral flank, characterized by a loss of standard fur texture and high contrast against the surrounding dark-brown tissue.
